summary: Benchmark 2023-B38 Mortgage Trust, a CMBS issuing entity, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to disclose a special servicer appointment. Effective September 1, 2026, C-IV Asset Management LLC became special servicer for two mortgage loans (Sentinel Square II and Centers of High Point) and related notes under the FIVE 2023-V1 pooling and servicing agreement. The change is administrative in nature, affecting servicing rights only, with no change to deal economics, collateral, or investor cash flows. No transaction, tender, or corporate action is involved, so this is not a special situation.
